units: jd: Julian dates in TT; mean: the mean ayanamsa, degrees, a star's in [-180, 180), a linear definition's in (-180, 180], an epoch definition's not wrapped; rate: its central difference over plus and minus 0.001 day of TT, degrees a day; closest: when ERFA's angle of the star from the Sun is least that year; leastElongation: that least angle, degrees; leastMarginAt: when ERFA's margin 1 + p·e less eraLdsun's dlim is least; capMargin: that least margin; capFromTo: when the cap starts and stops applying, the margin being below zero; nearCapFromTo: the ends of each stretch in which that margin is within NEAR_CAP, 5e-8, of zero; a definition's rate: arcseconds a Julian year
